----
title: "Ontology index"
description: "This directory contains the complete ontology documentation for BITwiki, establishing the formal structure for knowledge representation across the BIT"
type: index
author: "BITCORE"
created: "2026-02-11"
version: "1.0.0"
ontology:
  entity_type: index-document
  domain: navigation
epistemic_status: Attribution-Traced
confidence: Emerging
workflow:
  state: Beta
license: CC-BY-SA-4.0
----
= BITwiki Ontology Index =

== Overview ==

This document provides a comprehensive index of the BITwiki ontology, mapping the knowledge graph structure for the BITCORE ecosystem. The ontology is designed to be domain-neutral, extensible, and compatible with Semantic MediaWiki (SMW).

== Core Principles ==

=== Composable Type System ===

Instead of rigid entity lists, BITwiki uses a '''composable type system''' where entities can have multiple type annotations:
* Types are abstract enough to encompass diverse instances
* Multiple type annotations allowed per entity
* Relationships are flexible and context-dependent
* New specializations emerge organically through property composition

=== Event-Process-Value (EPV) Framework ===

The ontology implements the EPV pattern inspired by Wolfram's knowledge architecture:
* '''Events''' — Discrete occurrences or state changes
* '''Processes''' — Dynamic sequences and transformations
* '''Values''' — Measurements, assignments, or attributes

=== Epistemic Descriptors ===

Knowledge confidence is tracked using qualitative descriptors:

| Descriptor | Meaning |
|------------|---------|
| '''Established''' | Widely validated, consensus |
| '''Developing''' | Active validation ongoing |
| '''Preliminary''' | Initial evidence, needs review |
| '''Speculative''' | Hypothesis, limited evidence |
| '''Disputed''' | Active controversy |
| '''Deprecated''' | Superseded or obsolete |

== Entity Types ==

=== 1. Concept ===

'''Definition''': Abstract ideas, categories, mental constructs

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has definition` — Precise explanation
* `Has domain` — Knowledge domain(s)

'''Examples''':
* Knowledge Graph
* Semantic Web
* Ontology Design

=== 2. Process ===

'''Definition''': Dynamic sequences, workflows, transformations

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has process type` — Algorithm, Workflow, Procedure
* `Has input` — Required inputs
* `Has output` — Produced results

'''Examples''':
* Knowledge Graph Construction
* Ontology Development
* Research Methodology

=== 3. System ===

'''Definition''': Organized collections of interacting components

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has system type` — Classification
* `Has components` — Key elements
* `Has function` — Purpose or behavior

'''Examples''':
* BITwiki Platform
* Semantic MediaWiki
* Knowledge Graph Infrastructure

=== 4. Entity ===

'''Definition''': Distinct, identifiable things

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has identifier` — Unique name
* `Has description` — Brief characterization

'''Examples''':
* BITwiki
* Agent Zero
* Semantic Web

=== 5. Agent ===

'''Definition''': Entities capable of action/decision

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has agent type` — Human, Organization, AI
* `Has autonomy level` — Full, Delegated, Constrained
* `Has capability` — Perception, Reasoning, Action

'''Examples''':
* Research Teams
* Development Groups
* Intelligent Agents

=== 6. Artifact ===

'''Definition''': Created objects that carry knowledge

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has artifact type` — Document, Code, Dataset
* `Has creator` — Author(s)
* `Has creation date` — When created

'''Examples''':
* Ontology Specifications
* Research Papers
* Source Code

=== 7. Relationship ===

'''Definition''': Connections between entities

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has relationship type` — Classification
* `Has domain` — Valid source types
* `Has range` — Valid target types

'''Examples''':
* Depends On
* Implements
* Precedes

=== 8. Event ===

'''Definition''': Temporal occurrences with significance

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has event date` — When occurred
* `Has event type` — Discovery, Decision, Launch
* `Has significance` — Impact level

'''Examples''':
* Knowledge Graph Launch
* Ontology Revision
* Research Discovery

=== 9. State ===

'''Definition''': Conditions at a specific point in time

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has state type` — Classification
* `Has timestamp` — When recorded
* `Has configuration` — State description

'''Examples''':
* Draft State
* Review State
* Published State

=== 10. Data ===

'''Definition''': Structured information

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has data type` — Structured, Unstructured
* `Has format` — JSON, XML, CSV
* `Has source` — Origin

'''Examples''':
* Ontology Statistics
* Usage Analytics
* Quality Metrics

=== 11. Knowledge ===

'''Definition''': Justified true beliefs or validated information

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has knowledge type` — Factual, Procedural, Conceptual
* `Has epistemic status` — Established, Developing, etc.
* `Has justification` — Evidence basis

'''Examples''':
* Ontology Design Principles
* Research Findings
* Best Practices

=== 12. Model ===

'''Definition''': Simplified representations of phenomena

'''Required Properties''':
* `Has model type` — Mathematical, Computational, Conceptual
* `Has purpose` — Explanation, Prediction, Simulation
* `Has scope` — Domain of applicability

'''Examples''':
* EPV Framework
* Knowledge Graph Model
* Process Workflow Model

== Relationship Types ==

=== Structural Relationships ===

| Relationship | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Inverse |
|--------------|----------------|-------------|---------|
| `Instance of` | Any → Class | many-to-one | `Has instance` |
| `Part of` | Any → Any | many-to-many | `Has part` |
| `Related to` | Any → Any | many-to-many | symmetric |

=== Temporal Relationships ===

| Relationship | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Inverse |
|--------------|----------------|-------------|---------|
| `Precedes` | Event/Process → Event/Process | many-to-many | `Follows` |
| `Follows` | Event/Process → Event/Process | many-to-many | `Precedes` |
| `Concurrent with` | Event/Process → Event/Process | many-to-many | symmetric |

=== Causal Relationships ===

| Relationship | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Inverse |
|--------------|----------------|-------------|---------|
| `Influences` | Any → Any | many-to-many | `Influenced by` |
| `Causes` | Event/Action → Event/State | many-to-many | `Caused by` |
| `Enables` | Technology/Protocol → Application | many-to-many | `Enabled by` |

=== Implementation Relationships ===

| Relationship | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Inverse |
|--------------|----------------|-------------|---------|
| `Implements` | Implementation → Concept | many-to-many | `Implemented by` |
| `Uses` | Agent/Process → Tool/Resource | many-to-many | `Used by` |
| `Depends on` | Any → Any | many-to-many | `Required for` |

=== Social Relationships ===

| Relationship | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Inverse |
|--------------|----------------|-------------|---------|
| `Created by` | Artifact → Agent | many-to-many | `Creates` |
| `Member of` | Agent → Organization | many-to-many | `Has member` |
| `Collaborates with` | Agent → Agent | many-to-many | symmetric |

=== Epistemic Relationships ===

| Relationship | Domain → Range | Cardinality | Inverse |
|--------------|----------------|-------------|---------|
| `References` | Any → Resource | many-to-many | `Referenced by` |
| `Supports` | Data → Knowledge | many-to-many | `Supported by` |
| `Contradicts` | Data/Claim → Claim | many-to-many | symmetric |

== Property Naming Conventions ==

=== Verb Phrase Properties ===

All properties use verb phrases for clarity:
* ✅ `Has author` (not "Author")
* ✅ `Has creation date` (not "Creation date")
* ✅ `Implements concept` (not "Concept implementation")
* ✅ `Depends on` (not "Dependency")

=== Property Types ===

| SMW Type | Use Case |
|----------|----------|
| `Page` | References to other entities |
| `Text` | Short strings, identifiers |
| `URL` | Web references |
| `Date` | Timestamps |
| `Number` | Quantities |
| `Boolean` | True/False flags |

== File Structure ==

```
hyperion/book-matter/ontology/
├── BITwiki_Entity_Types.wiki          # Entity specifications
├── BITwiki_Ontology_Index.wiki        # Complete schema reference
├── BITwiki_Relationship_Types.wiki    # Relationship taxonomy
├── BITwiki_Semantic_Patterns.wiki     # Design patterns
├── BITwiki_Taxonomy_Architecture.wiki # Category hierarchy
├── Ontology_index.md                  # This index
└── expansion/
    ├── BITwiki_Epistemic_Status_Taxonomy.wiki
    ├── BITwiki_Expanded_Entity_Types.wiki
    ├── BITwiki_Ontology_Alignment_Matrix.wiki
    ├── BITwiki_Relationship_Pattern_Catalog.wiki
    ├── BITwiki_Visual_Diagram_Specification.wiki
    └── INDEX.md
```

== SMW Integration ==

=== Property Declaration ===

```mediawiki
[[Has property description::Description of property]]
[[Has type::Page|Text|Number|Date|URL|Boolean]]
```

=== Entity Declaration ===

```mediawiki
[[Is a::Concept]]
[[Has definition::Definition text]]
[[Has domain::Ontology]]
[[Has epistemic status::Established]]
```

=== Query Example ===

```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Established]] [[Has domain::Ontology]]
 |?Has entity type
 |?Has definition
 |format=table
}}
```

== Research Foundation ==

This ontology is based on:
* '''Wolfram EPV Model''' — Event-Process-Value framework
* '''Semantic MediaWiki Best Practices''' — Property and type system
* '''FAIR Principles''' — Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable
* '''Wikidata Ontology Patterns''' — Composable entity design

== Version ==
* '''Version''': 2.0.0
* '''Date''': 2026-02-10
* '''Status''': Revised per HUMAN_REVIEW.md directives

== See Also ==
* [BITwiki:Entity Types](BITwiki_Entity_Types.wiki)
* [BITwiki:Ontology Index](BITwiki_Ontology_Index.wiki)
* [BITwiki:Relationship Types](BITwiki_Relationship_Types.wiki)
* [BITwiki:Semantic Patterns](BITwiki_Semantic_Patterns.wiki)
* [BITwiki:Taxonomy Architecture](BITwiki_Taxonomy_Architecture.wiki)

| `Supports` | Data → Knowledge | many-to-many | `Supported by` |
| `Contradicts` | Data/Claim → Claim | many-to-many | symmetric |

== Property Naming Conventions ==

=== Verb Phrase Properties ===

All properties use verb phrases for clarity:
* ✅ `Has author` (not "Author")
* ✅ `Has creation date` (not "Creation date")
* ✅ `Implements concept` (not "Concept implementation")
* ✅ `Depends on` (not "Dependency")

=== Property Types ===

| SMW Type | Use Case |
|----------|----------|
| `Page` | References to other entities |
| `Text` | Short strings, identifiers |
| `URL` | Web references |
| `Date` | Timestamps |
| `Number` | Quantities |
| `Boolean` | True/False flags |
